finalText:
I've redone the GitPanel canvas in a simpler style. It keeps all five states (Changes, Save a version, Publish, Nothing to save, Publish rejected) with the same artboard ids and sizes. It passes `maude design check`, and I took a screenshot of each artboard. The screenshots are small, so they confirm the layout of each state but not fine detail.

**What changed**
- **Studio frame:** the top bar keeps just the Maude mark, "maude / main" as plain text and the avatars. The "N unsaved" count there is gone because the panel already shows it. The canvas preview is now a plain card on a flat background, with no dots.
- **File tree:** no file icons. M/A/D/U show as coloured letters instead of filled pills.
- **Changes list:** one flat list, no "Modified / Added…" headings. Each row has a checkbox, the name and the letter. Files left out of the version show slightly dimmer. File paths now appear on hover instead of on a second line.
- **Save area:** the message box sits above a single row with "x of y selected" and **Save version**. I removed "Save all".
- **Panel header:** the title and count stay; the "More" button is gone. The count now reads 6, matching the six files listed (it said 4 before).
- **History:** plain rows with the message and "who · files · when", without the timeline line and dots.
- **Publish:** "Get latest" is now a quiet box without the pulsing dot. Buttons no longer have icons. The hint is shorter.
- **Nothing to save:** a single check mark, without the large Maude logo above it. "View History" is now "View history".
- **Publish rejected:** a calm amber box with a title, one sentence and two buttons. The list underneath is now titled "Waiting to publish".
- **Styling:** I rewrote `GitPanel.css`, which only this canvas uses. It has one border weight and uses the design system's font-weight and canvas-colour tokens instead of fixed values.

**What I left alone**
- **"Changes" tab:** it's locked, so it's exactly as it was. Unlock it with ⇧⌘L if you want it changed too.
- **Element ids:** every element I kept still has its id. I removed the "More" button, "Save all", the top-bar count and the large logo on the "Nothing to save" screen.
- **Older design-system warnings:** the canvas still imports the design-system CSS itself, uses the `maude` wrapper and draws the logo as inline SVG. These predate this change.

The system blocked my first two shell commands because it couldn't check them before they ran. I ran the same checks and screenshots again as plain commands, and those worked.
